description: Linkerd proxy metrics for one meshed deployment in a dis-core cluster: inbound and outbound HTTP success rate, request rate and latency, TCP connections, and a breakdown per calling and called deployment.

panels.description: Share of inbound HTTP responses classified as successful.

targets.expr:
sum(rate(response_total{classification="success", namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum(rate(response_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Success rate

panels.description: Inbound requests per second.

targets.expr: sum(rate(request_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request rate

panels.description: Meshed deployments sending requests to this deployment. 0 when traffic only arrives from outside the mesh (e.g. Traefik).

targets.expr: count(count by (namespace, deployment) (request_total{dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", deployment!="", direction="outbound"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Inbound deployments

panels.description: Deployments (per namespace) this deployment sends requests to.

targets.expr: count(count by (dst_namespace, dst_deployment) (request_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound", dst_deployment!=""})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Outbound deployments

panels.description: Share of inbound HTTP responses Linkerd classified as successful.

targets.expr:
sum by (deployment) (rate(response_total{classification="success", namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (deployment) (rate(response_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Success rate

panels.description: Inbound requests per second, split by whether the connection was mTLS.

targets.expr: sum by (deployment) (rate(request_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound", tls="true"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (deployment) (rate(request_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound", tls!="true"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request rate

panels.description: Inbound response latency (p50, p95, p99).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, deployment) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, deployment) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, deployment) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Latency

panels.description: Inbound TCP connection errors per second, by error type.

targets.expr: sum by (error) (rate(inbound_tcp_errors_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP errors

panels.description: Open inbound TCP connections, by peer (src = client side, dst = server side).

targets.expr: sum by (peer) (tcp_open_connections{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"})

panels.title: TCP connections open

panels.description: New inbound TCP connections per second, by peer.

targets.expr: sum by (peer) (rate(tcp_open_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="inbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TCP connection rate

panels.description: Share of inbound HTTP responses Linkerd classified as successful.

targets.expr:
sum by (pod) (rate(response_total{classification="success", deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval]))
/
sum by (pod) (rate(response_total{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Success rate

panels.description: Inbound requests per second, split by whether the connection was mTLS.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(request_total{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound", tls="true"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (pod) (rate(request_total{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound", tls!="true"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request rate

panels.description: Inbound response latency (p50, p95, p99).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, pod) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, pod) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, pod) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{deployment="$inbound", dst_namespace="$namespace", dst_deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval])))

targets.expr:

sum by (dst_namespace, dst_deployment) (rate(response_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (dst_namespace, dst_deployment) (rate(request_total{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound", tls!="true"}[$__rate_interval]))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, dst_namespace, dst_deployment) (rate(response_latency_ms_bucket{namespace="$namespace", deployment="$deployment", direction="outbound"}[$__rate_interval])))
